title: "Photograph of Dodonovo Atomic Energy complex taken by a Project GENETRIX balloon"
description: Annotated black-and-white aerial reconnaissance photograph of an industrial complex along a river, with an enlarged inset at upper left. Overlay labels include "SPOIL," "NUCLEAR STORAGE AREA," "HEAD FRAME AREA," "PROB ORE CRUSHING PLANT," "ELECTRIFIED RAIL" and a river name. Captioned "Photograph of Dodonovo Atomic Energy complex taken by a Project GENETRIX balloon"; the text discusses Eisenhower halting the balloon project after Soviet protests (Chapter 2, p. 86).
